question: Which of the following properties remain(s) the same in a homologous series?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chemical properties.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Homologous series** refers to a group of **organic compounds** that have the** same functional group** and **similar chemical properties.**
 
• They **differ** from each other by the** number of carbon atoms** in their chain.
 
• A homologous series has a **regular increase** in the** molecular mass **due to the addition of a **methylene group (-CH2-)** in each successive compound.
 
• The molecular mass of the compounds in a homologous series** increases by a constant value, **which is equal to the molecular mass of the -CH2- group.
 
• Therefore, theChemical properties remain the same because all members of a homologous series have the same functional group, which dictates the chemical behavior of the molecule.
 
• Melting and boiling points of the compounds in a homologous series show a** regular increase** with increasing molecular mass due to the increase in intermolecular forces of attraction.
 
• Chemical properties of the compounds in a homologous series are determined by the **functional group** present in them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **melting point **of a compound is the temperature at which it changes from a** solid to a liquid **state.

 
 
• It depends on the strength of the **intermolecular forces of attraction** between the molecules of the compound.
 
 
 
• The **boiling point **of a compound is the temperature at which it changes from a** liquid to a gaseous** state.
 
 
• It depends on the strength of the **intermolecular forces of attraction** between the molecules of the compound.
 
 
 
• The **molecular mass** of a compound is the sum of the atomic masses of all the atoms present in a molecule of the compound.
 
• The** chemical properties** of a compound are determined by the** functional group** present in it.
 
 
• The functional group determines how the compound **reacts** with other substances.
